The [[Iskalon system/Legends|Iskalon system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Gamandar]], [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]], and [[Telfrey]].

==History==
The system was [[Subjugation of the Iskalon system|subjugated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
